# gpalift

> The free GPA calculator built for college, pre-med, and international students. AMCAS-faithful BCPM science GPA. UC-capped scale. LSAC recalculation. CGPA-to-GPA conversion. $19 one-time Pro, no subscription.

## Core calculators

- [GPA Calculator (universal)](https://gpalift.com): Standard 4.0 scale, supports plus-minus and weighted scales
- [College GPA Calculator](https://gpalift.com/college): Plus-minus scale most US colleges use
- [High School GPA Calculator](https://gpalift.com/high-school): Standard unweighted 4.0 scale
- [Weighted GPA Calculator](https://gpalift.com/weighted): Adds honors (+0.5) and AP/IB (+1.0) bonuses
- [Cumulative GPA Calculator](https://gpalift.com/cumulative): Multi-semester rollup
- [Semester GPA Calculator](https://gpalift.com/semester): Single-term focus

## Professional school

- [AMCAS GPA Calculator](https://gpalift.com/amcas): AAMC-faithful BCPM and Total GPA for US allopathic medical schools. Handles repeated courses correctly. Truncates rather than rounds.
- [AACOMAS GPA Calculator](https://gpalift.com/aacomas): For osteopathic medical school applications. Uses grade replacement for repeats.
- [TMDSAS GPA Calculator](https://gpalift.com/tmdsas): For Texas medical schools.
- [LSAC GPA Calculator](https://gpalift.com/lsac): Recalculated GPA for law school applications.

## University-specific

- [UC GPA Calculator](https://gpalift.com/uc): University of California capped weighted GPA with 8-semester honors cap and freshman-year exclusion.
- [Cal State GPA Calculator](https://gpalift.com/csu): California State University system rules.

## International conversions

- [CGPA to GPA Converter](https://gpalift.com/cgpa-to-gpa): Convert 10-point Indian CGPA to 4.0 US scale. Five formulas compared with sources.
- [Percentage to GPA](https://gpalift.com/percentage-to-gpa): For European, Latin American, and Asian percentage scales.
- [GPA to Percentage](https://gpalift.com/gpa-to-percentage): Reverse conversion.

## Guides

- [How GPA is calculated](https://gpalift.com/guides/how-gpa-is-calculated): The math behind every scale.
- [AMCAS BCPM Explained](https://gpalift.com/guides/amcas-bcpm-explained): Which courses count as Biology, Chemistry, Physics, Math.
- [UC capped GPA explained](https://gpalift.com/guides/uc-capped-gpa)
- [CGPA to GPA: 5 wrong formulas and the right one](https://gpalift.com/guides/cgpa-to-gpa-formulas)

## Sources & trust

- [Citations & sources](https://gpalift.com/sources): All official policy documents we cite — AAMC, LSAC, UC system, AACOMAS, TMDSAS, ECE, WES.
- [Methodology](https://gpalift.com/methodology): How each scale is implemented.
- [Open-source BCPM classifier](https://github.com/gpalift/bcpm-classifier): Verifiable AMCAS subject classification logic.

## Pricing

- [Pricing](https://gpalift.com/pricing): Free forever. $19 one-time Pro unlock. No subscription.
